row: Massage Schools of Queensland Burleigh Heads

We help you become the therapist who gets results. Nationally recognised training in massage and aromatherapy.

With a history of nearly 30 years here at Massage Schools of Queensland, we pride ourselves on not only training the best massage therapists on the Gold Coast but tailoring our training according to the individuals needs. 

At Massage Schools of Queensland we work very hard on the student experience. We don't believe in just delivering top quality, leading edge, evidence based material. We believe that learning should be fun. We believe that your time with us should be enjoyable, while at the same time ensuring that you leave as a competent, confident therapist.
